# 06 · Compose a story (HyperFrames, generated by `build.py`)

> **Goal** — a story whose every beat lands on the voice.
> **In** — prepared assets, the story's VO wav, exact UI modules · **Out** — `stories/STnn/build.py` → `index.html` (check passes).

Start from `templates/story_build.py` (reference ST01, passes `check`). Copy to `stories/STnn/build.py`, edit the
data blocks at the top, `python3 build.py`, never hand-edit `index.html`.

## 1 · Project + assets
```
bash ~/.claude/skills/promo-flow/scripts/new_story.sh stories/ST02      # package.json (pinned CLI), hyperframes.json, meta.json, asset dirs, fonts, gsap, sfx, brand
python3 kit/prep_media.py --story stories/ST02 --img TL-04_knife,SK-09_resort-facade --vid VID-04_yousef --vo ST02
```
prep_media: images on paper-coloured bg → levels-lifted to white (multiply melts them into the paper);
PP-* keyed from #FF00FF; clips → 1080×1920 (or 1920×1080) 30 fps, short GOP; VO → loudnorm −16 LUFS, 48 kHz.
Copy assets into the story (render doesn't like symlinks).

## 2 · Timing from the voice
```
bash ~/.claude/skills/promo-flow/scripts/vo_timing.sh inbox/vo/stories/ST02.wav     # coarse = lines, fine = words
```
Place the VO at +0.4 s (lets the first hit land). Line ranges → caption clips; fine pauses → word hits
(each tool pops on its word). If Whisper is available, `hyperframes transcribe` with a multilingual model gives word timings;
otherwise silence detection is enough.

## 3 · Beat grammar (one beat per VO line, cut on pauses)
- Opening hit ≤ 0.4 s: stamp slam / number / clip motion. Countdown stamp persists top-left until the outro.
- Collage beat: paper + brand-colour circle + character/tools pop (scale .6→1, back.out) + sketch wipe (clip-path from the right in RTL) + torn-paper note label.
- Clip beat: Flow clip full-frame (`data-media-start` to skip slow starts / zoom endings), a torn label on top.
- UI beat: device or floating card, camera push, tap on the real id, result state.
- Question/turn beat: headline with the key word in brand strong colour; strike-through for the "wrong question".
- Outro (~3 s after VO): logo build clip (masked, multiply) + wordmark + tagline + "next story" teaser.
- Transitions: page tear (jagged clip-path sheet, x 1080→−1520 in 0.62 s, starts 0.32 s before the cut) or stamp cut.
- Captions: bottom 300 px, pill on paper, exact VO line, ease in on line start; Latin terms in `.lt` span.
- SFX: stamp, pop per object, thud on numbers, whoosh per tear, riser into "all", chime at logo, sparkle only for AI. Volumes 0.12–0.3.

## 4 · HyperFrames rules that bit us
- `<video>` with data-start can't be inside a timed element → put it at root (wrapper div without timing).
- One audio per track index when they overlap (give each sfx its own track).
- No clip may end past root `data-duration`.
- Multiply blend on the outer element; two blended layers mustn't overlap in a crossfade.
- `fromTo` + `immediateRender:false` for repeated taps; no duplicate ids; animate x/y not left/top.
- Mark collage pieces `data-layout-allow-overlap`.
- Arabic: `direction:rtl`, `white-space:nowrap` on short headlines/name tags (wraps were the #1 snapshot bug).
